text:
jane.cho: Heads up — SCIM sync started failing for multiple service accounts after yesterday's RBAC prune. Getting repeated 403s when adding users to groups. Anyone on call can take a look?
omar.khan: I can. Which org / example request id?
jane.cho: org=acme-corp, top example request id=req_20260316_0345. Error seen in app logs: 
```
2026-03-16T03:45:12Z ERROR scim: provision failed req=req_20260316_0345 svc=svcacc-ingest-01 status=403 reason=forbidden action=group_write
2026-03-16T03:45:12Z DEBUG auth: principal=scim-provisioner-robot roles=[scim_provisioner] allowed=false
```
luis: I'm seeing correlated KMS decrypt warnings around the same time in key-manager: 
```
2026-03-16T03:45:10Z WARN kms: decrypt failed alias=alias/scim-token-keys err="context mismatch" ctx_id=ctx_9f3e
2026-03-16T03:45:10Z INFO kms: key-usage-check alias=alias/scim-token-keys last-rotate=2026-02-28T01:00:00Z
```
sec-oncall: tagging owners @omar.khan @luis @maria_g — this looks like a chain: RBAC change => KMS alias rotation? Could be tokens decrypted with old context.
omar.khan: pulling audit logs now. Quick note: yesterday we removed wildcard write for "scim:*" roles during the RBAC hardening. Might've affected the scim_provisioner role if it had an implicit grant.
maria_g: Confirmed: change PR #789 removed "group_write" from role-template service-integration:scim-provisioner when we tightened external-id permissions. That was intentional for human accounts but I think service accounts were using the same template.
jane.cho: Ugh — service accounts were never split. We do have mitigation: a short-term allow rule for svcaccs, but tokens are failing to decrypt per KMS logs.
kms-bot: KMS alert: alias/scim-token-keys rotated 2026-03-01T01:00:00Z; detected envelope-context-version mismatch for 12 tokens since rotation. See ticket KMS-4521.
luis: So two things: 1) RBAC remove caused explicit deny on group_write for the principal; 2) tokens minted before alias rotation can't be decrypted with new context. Combined they look like 403s in provisioner.
sec-oncall: Attack surface note: CVE triage — removing wildcard write was intentional (vuln mitigation). Re-allowing temporarily increases blast radius. We should do limited exception + short TTL tokens instead of global revert.
omar.khan: Agreed. Proposed immediate actions: 
- Grant a scoped temporary exception: role=scim_provisioner svc filter=principal:svcacc-* allow=group_write until 2026-03-18T12:00:00Z (2 days)
- Backfill: re-encrypt old tokens with current KMS context for infected svcaccs (or revoke and rotate tokens)
- Add audit rule: flag all scim group_write by service accounts to high-fidelity audit stream
- Create migration to split human vs svcacc role templates
maria_g: I can push the RBAC exception (infra RBAC stores change). Who will handle the token rotation/re-encrypt?
luis: I'll coordinate with KMS infra. Short plan: list affected tokens (from KMS-4521), revoke + issue new tokens scoped to the temporary exception. Will script revocation to avoid manual mistakes.
jane.cho: For immediate customer impact: acme-corp impacted users = ~12 groups. I'll trigger a manual retry for those req ids after we restore exception and rotate tokens.
deploy-bot: deploy-hook: ACL change applied to role=scim_provisioner scope=svcacc-* by maria_g at 2026-03-16T04:02:11Z (change-id rb-20260316-1) :thumbsup:
maria_g: Done — exception created with 48h expiry. Logging increased to audit-high.
sec-oncall: Good. Next: luis, please post expected ETA for token reissue. Also add a postmortem stub in /incidents with timeline.
luis: ETA ~45m to script revoke + new token issuance for affected svcaccs, then verification run. I'll update KMS-4521 and ping here.
omar.khan: I'll run a targeted retry for req_20260316_0345 once luis confirms new token.
jane.cho: Thanks. Also leaving a note — we should mark this as a regression in our change window because RBAC PR removed implicit grant that service accounts depended on.
sec-oncall: Agreed — postmortem should include remediation: 1) split templates, 2) KMS rotation preflight check to re-encrypt tokens or reject overlapping rotations, 3) add canary svcacc to detect RBAC breaks in staging first.
luis: Update: token reissue script completed at 2026-03-16T04:41:00Z, new tokens issued, KMS reports successful decrypt for new tokens.
omar.khan: Retry succeeded — req_20260316_0345 now 200.
jane.cho: Verified acme-corp groups synced. Closing customer ticket and will file follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :tada:
sec-oncall: Filing incident #INC-20260316-01 with summary + mitigation steps. Please add any missing notes in the ticket.
jane.cho: adding timeline and logs now.
maria_g: we should schedule a debrief tomorrow to update RBAC templates.
luis: ack.
